capabilities: Convert Obsidian Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML
Publish notes to WeChat Official Account via official API
Render Mermaid diagrams as PNG images and upload them
Upload local images to the WeChat media library
Preview WeChat article rendering in a sidebar before publishing
extras: Supports only WeChat today; other platforms (Zhihu, Juejin, CSDN) are on the roadmap. UI commands and menus are partly in Chinese. Embeds (![[...]]) are not yet converted. Daily WeChat API limits and a 2MB image cap apply.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to WeChat Official Account, and WeChat requires converted HTML, uploaded images, and platform-specific formatting.

relations.evidence: Referenced DOM processing, image upload, and media library management
Referenced Mermaid SVG→PNG conversion, cover upload, and code block handling
Referenced markdown-it + juice rendering, CSS inline strategy, and code block styling

requires.name: verified WeChat Official Account (subscription or service account)
WeChat Official Account AppID and AppSecret

summary: Publishing plugin that converts and uploads Obsidian notes as articles to WeChat Official Account via its official API.
